Sports Illustrated's Conor Orr and Gilberto Manzano break down the Minnesota Vikings' impressive win over the Green Bay Packers and make the case for Cousins as a legitimate MVP candidate. The guys discuss Cousins' impact on Justin Jefferson, how his experience has transformed Minnesota's offense, and why the Vikings' defense makes them a dangerous postseason opponent.
